name: yt-flywheel-team
description: YouTube Evergreen Flywheel — 14-skill AI Agent Team split into two clean layers. LAYER A (Playlist Strategy, runs once per playlist): playlist-strategy-orchestrator + Agent 01 decide the whole playlist concept, umbrella keyword, video sequence and per-video keyword map, then emit a formal PlaylistStrategy doc plus one pre-generated Video Brief Card per planned video. LAYER B (Per-Video Execution, runs every video): video-production-orchestrator consumes one Brief Card and runs SEO title/description, script, production core, thumbnail, publish — no strategy work at video time. The Video Brief Card is the interface (references/layer-interface.md). strategic-launch-orchestrator is a thin wrapper: playlist strategy, then funnel build (delegated to email-list-building), then opt-in URL storage. Multi-channel, outputs in Google Drive.
